paragraphs.text: Thromok is a legendary hellion from an unknown plane.

Thromok the Insatiable is a colossal hellion with a sleek, limbless body lined with jagged spikes. These spikes serve as natural armor and aid it in burrowing through the earth with terrifying speed and power. Its mouth radiates an aura of volcanic heat, intensified by the bright-burning glow emanating from deep within its gullet. The glow casts an eerie light, especially when Thromok's massive mouth opens behind its numerous huge mandibles. These mandibles are designed to crush and devour anything unfortunate enough to be caught in its path. The creature's hunger is insatiable, relentlessly consuming everything, growing ever more powerful with each creature it devours. Thromok is a true force of nature, embodying the destructive and consuming power of fire and earth.
